subject: Television & Streaming
title: Ryan Murphy and the Content Factory
description: A fast breakdown of Ryan Murphy and the Content Factory for builders.

hook.text: Ryan Murphy has created over 25 TV series. At one point, he had shows running on four different networks simultaneously.

buildup.text: Nip/Tuck, Glee, American Horror Story, Pose—Murphy jumps between genres like no other creator in television.

discovery.text: Netflix signed him to a $300 million deal. He became one of the highest-paid showrunners in history.

twist.text: Critics argue quantity dilutes quality. Many Murphy shows start brilliantly but lose focus midseason.

climax.text: Murphy's impact is undeniable. He put LGBTQ+ stories on mainstream TV when few others would take the risk.

punchline.text: He creates more TV than anyone and apologizes for none of it.

quiz.question: What cultural impact did Ryan Murphy have on mainstream television?
options: He put LGBTQ+ stories on mainstream television
He invented the limited series format
